ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select name from sysobjects where name = 'POS_EksportRelacjeGrupKontrahentow' and type = 'P') drop procedure CDN.POS_EksportRelacjeGrupKontrahentow;

CREATE PROCEDURE [CDN].[POS_EksportRelacjeGrupKontrahentow] @rowVersion bigint, @PointOfSaleId int AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
SELECT @rowVersion+1 AS [@RowVersion] ,( select Kng_syncId as [@Id], KnG_GrONumer as [@ParentGroupId], KnG_GIDNumer as [@ChildGroupId] from cdn.PicoKonfig join cdn.PicoStanowiska on pck_picoid = psa_pckid outer apply cdn.PobierzDrzewoGrupKontrahentow(PcK_KnGENumer,default) outer apply [CDN].[PobierzDrzewoGrupKntKuKorzeniowi](AktuGIDNumer,-32,AktuGrONumer) join cdn.KntGrupy on KnG_GIDNumer = PobierzDrzewoGrupKontrahentow.AktuGidNumer and KnG_GIDTyp = -32 where psa_id =@PointOfSaleId AND PobierzDrzewoGrupKontrahentow.Poziom = [PobierzDrzewoGrupKntKuKorzeniowi].Poziom and KnG_GIDNumer <> PcK_KnGENumer for xml path('CustomerGroupRelation'), type) for xml path('CustomerGroupRelations') SET NOCOUNT OFF; END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.POS_EksportRelacjeGrupKontrahentow TO CDNRaport
